title: Immersive World
description: Vanilla faithful survival modpack, with focus on a world that feels alive and immersive, without losing the core that makes minecraft great.
body:
Vanilla faithful survival modpack, with focus on a world that feels alive and immersive, without losing the core that makes minecraft great.

- Enhances world generation, adds new structures that fit the theme, without going overboard.

- Adds new items, weapons and armor.

- Quality of life additions like tombstones and a world map.

Core mods:
- Immersion:
  - The Roads more travelled
  - Burnt
  - Immersive Weathering
  - Fabric Seasons

- QOL:
  - Comforts
  - Tombstones
  - Distracting Trims

 ... And a lot more to discover. :)
